name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) captures 'If you move the ball, you must also take the key' ('also' gives the no-timing reading). 'Then pick up the box in the other room' is a commanded goal, so Existence(target_picked_up) hard is correct; the 'Then' links it after the key, giving Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up), and after moving the ball when it happens, giving Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up). The redundant warning on R1 is fine: it is an 'if' rule the task states, so it stays.

texts: If the ball is moved, the matching door key must also be taken at some point (before, with, or after moving the ball).
Eventually pick up the mission's target box.
Take the matching door key before picking up the target box.
Whenever the ball has been moved, the target box must be picked up at that step or later.
